📺 Shelter Swap — Kathambi is on.

Two villagers swap shelters for a week. The aliens film the adjustment. Someone always cries about someone else's storage system.

You watch with the village. The cameras love the watchers almost as much as the watched — what you do in the crowd is content too.

📺 The waves are coming. They feint at the barricade — and come for YOU.

The village gasps as one. Someone on the wall is screaming your name.

Three waves. Hold the line.
